lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Core as Core Event Committer
    participant Journal as Portable Runtime Journal
    participant Commit as Portable Commit Coordinator
    participant Policy as Export Policy
    participant Artifacts as Artifact CAS
    participant Segments as Segment Repository
    participant FS as Workspace Adapter
    participant Consumer as Invocation Broker / Lifecycle / Worker Gateway

    Core->>Commit: PrepareCommitBatch(CommitId, expected head, events, PortableCheckpointRecordV1)
    Commit->>Policy: scrub complete batch and artifact intents
    alt forbidden or ambiguous portable data
        Policy-->>Commit: rejected(reason, jsonPointers)
        Commit-->>Core: CommitRejectedV1 with nothing published
    else sanitized
        Policy-->>Commit: SanitizedPortableBatchV1
        loop each permitted artifact
            Commit->>Artifacts: prepare and verify inert bytes
            Artifacts->>FS: create-new, fsync, rename CAS object
            FS-->>Artifacts: durable artifact hash
        end
        Commit->>Segments: prepare bounded parent-linked JSONL and PortableCheckpointRecordV1
        Segments->>FS: create-new, fsync, rename immutable objects
        FS-->>Segments: durable segment and checkpoint hashes
        Commit-->>Core: PreparedPortableCommitV1(request hash, object hashes, proposed head)

        Core->>Journal: BeginPortableCommit(PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1, prepared identity, operational facts)
        alt journal transaction is not durable
            Journal-->>Core: JournalWriteFailedV1
            Note over Core,FS: No head publication and no acknowledgement. Prepared objects remain unreachable delayed orphan candidates
        else PendingPortableCommit is durable
            Journal-->>Core: PendingPortableCommitDurableV1
            Core->>Commit: PublishPreparedHead(CommitId, expected head, proposed head)
            Commit->>FS: read branch ref under expected-head guard
            alt current head differs, binding drifts, or sibling claim exists
                FS-->>Commit: head conflict and verified tips
                Commit-->>Core: ConcurrentContinuationV1(common portable checkpoint, tips)
                Core->>Journal: QuarantineBinding(observed head and binding proof)
                Journal-->>Core: QuarantinedV1
                Note over Core,Consumer: No timestamp merge, silent adaptation, or success. Core explicitly creates a new child continuation after fresh binding
            else expected head and binding match
                Commit->>FS: publish immutable HeadRecord and head claim
                Commit->>FS: atomic replace BranchHeadRef and fsync directory
                alt crash or durability failure before ref commit
                    FS-->>Commit: not durable or response ambiguous
                    Commit-->>Core: no success and VerifyCommitIdentityV1 required
                    Note over Journal,FS: Journal remains PendingPortableCommit and recovery uses only the exact prepared identities
                else durable ref committed
                    FS-->>Commit: AtomicWriteReceiptV1
                    Commit-->>Core: PortableCommitReceiptV1(exact head, segment, PortableCheckpointRecordV1, cursor)
                    Core->>Commit: VerifyCommitIdentityV1 from a fresh branch-head read
                    alt CommitId, head, parent, branch, or checkpoint hash differs
                        Commit-->>Core: CommitIdentityMismatchV1
                        Core->>Journal: QuarantineBinding(observed proof)
                        Journal-->>Core: QuarantinedV1
                        Note over Core,Consumer: Portable history stays inspectable and no success is released
                    else portable head identity is verified
                        Commit-->>Core: VerifiedPortableCommitV1
                        Core->>Journal: FinalizeHeadLinked(verified receipt and exact hashes)
                        alt HeadLinked transaction is not durable
                            Journal-->>Core: JournalFinalizeFailedV1
                            Note over Core,Consumer: No success. Recovery verifies the portable head and idempotently finalizes later
                        else portable and journal states are both verified
                            Journal-->>Core: HeadLinkedDurableV1
                            Core-->>Consumer: CoreCommittedAckV1 and release eligible delivery
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

data.title: Atomic portable append, runtime-journal link, verified head, and acknowledgement
